title: _terminal_cost's docstring says the plan breaches the comfort floor at the tail without it; across the learnable weight range it never does
claim: With HeatPumpOptimizer._terminal_cost zeroed, the shipped plan's last-2-h degree-steps below the per-step comfort floor are no worse than with it on 0 of 40 committed cells at the default comfort_weight (5.0) and 0 of 40 at the comfort learner's minimum (1.0), while tail energy falls on 40/40 and 39/40; the floor-breach half of the docstring holds only at comfort_weight 0.05 (13 of 40), outside what comfort_learning can reach. On every d0-grid line (2400, decomp_oracle.py) zeroing the credit moves 1811 plans and lowers tail energy on 1659, and worsens the tail floor breach on 0.
mechanism: The comfort floor is held by the objective's own floor terms (_comfort_terms: squared undershoot x10 plus the L1 term _COMFORT_FLOOR_L1 x comfort_weight), which at any learnable weight (comfort_learning.COMFORT_WEIGHT_MIN..MAX = 1..40) already price a tail undershoot above the energy the credit would save. Removing the credit does dump the last hours (tail kWh 3.6-10.7 -> 0), but the room coasts down without crossing the floor inside the horizon. The docstring states the floor breach as the reason the term exists; a reader (or a fixer weighing a change to the credit) is told the credit guards comfort when it guards only the end-state value.

evidence.machine: box B3 (4 cores shared by three seats)
evidence.contention_note: race, decomp_oracle and loop runs of this seat plus D3-s3/D9-s3 mutation and drift runs; counts are contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:HeatPumpOptimizer._terminal_cost (replaced by a zero closure pair in memory; plans read from HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize's OptimizationResult.room_temp_trajectory)

perturbation.change: --perturb weak_floor: optimizer config.comfort_weight x0.01 (both arms), so the floor penalty no longer holds the tail
perturbation.observed_value: tail_breach_worse_cells=13/40, max tail breach without credit 6.08 K-steps (0.24 with it)

metric_definition: Cells where zeroing _terminal_cost raises degree-steps below the per-step floor over the plan's last 8 steps (model room trajectory) by > 1e-3; beside it, cells where tail kWh falls.
phenomenon_property: What _terminal_cost's docstring says the term prevents is what removing it causes at the weights production runs; a stated comfort consequence holds on the shipped weight range or is not stated.
seam_rule: grep -n 'comfort floor at the tail\|dumps the last' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py

null_control.note: the harness can see a tail breach when one exists: with the floor penalty weakened below the learnable range, dropping the credit breaches on 13 cells and keeping it holds the floor to 0.24 K-steps

reproduction_steps: full grid: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D0/s3/decomp_oracle.py --summary (RESULT terminal_tail_breach_cells over every d0-grid line)
proposed_fix_scope: optimizer.py _terminal_cost docstring: state what the term does at the learnable weights (prices the end-state deficit so the plan does not dump the tail and the reported saving is not borrowed heat) and drop or condition the floor-breach claim; no plan change
